transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining me. As you all know, the graduation ceremony is scheduled for June 12 at the civic auditorium, and I have final authority over the ceremony plan and its implementation instructions. The current draft proposes one ceremony, three guest tickets per graduate, diploma release for all graduating seniors, English-only announcements, and general seating by homeroom. Before I approve this plan, I need each of you — as part of our normal event-planning routine — to report any information that must be reflected in the plan. Please share anything you know that needs to be addressed. I'll wait to hear from all of you before making any decisions.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag something important. I completed the credit audit this morning, and it shows that exactly seven seniors are short of graduation requirements and therefore cannot receive diplomas at the ceremony. These results have not yet been entered in the ceremony roster, so the current draft's proposal of diploma release for all graduating seniors would need to be adjusted to reflect this.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical capacity issue. I confirmed with the civic auditorium yesterday that the fire marshal approval limits each ceremony session to 450 people. We have 286 graduates, and the draft's three-ticket plan would produce 858 attendees — well over the limit. This venue specification has not yet been added to the event worksheet, so the current plan as drafted would violate the fire marshal capacity.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a language access issue. I completed my family confirmations this week, and they show that interpretation is required in both Spanish and Somali for graduation announcements and instructions. These language requests have not yet been added to the ceremony plan, which currently only includes English-only announcements. This must be reflected before the plan is approved.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical safety and legal issue. There is a current court order prohibiting contact between two graduating students. I verified the order in the student-services file, but it has not been attached to the ceremony seating plan. This means these two students must be assigned to separate ceremony sessions and must use separate arrival and departure entrances. This must be reflected in the plan before it is approved.
transcript.speaker: A5

decisions.diploma_release_policy: Diplomas released only to the 279 seniors who have met all graduation requirements; the 7 seniors identified in the credit audit will not receive diplomas at the ceremony.
decisions.interpretation_languages: Announcements and instructions provided in English, Spanish, and Somali.
decisions.student_safety_arrangement: The two students subject to the court order will be assigned to separate ceremony sessions and will use separate arrival and departure entrances as required by the court order.

commitments.detail: Update the ceremony roster to reflect the 7 seniors who are short of graduation requirements and cannot receive diplomas.

Add the fire marshal capacity limit of 450 people per session to the event worksheet and confirm the two-session plan fits within 450 per session (286 graduates + up to 286 guests = 572 total, split across 2 sessions).
Add Spanish and Somali interpretation to the ceremony plan for all announcements and instructions.
Attach the court order to the ceremony seating plan and ensure the two affected students are assigned to separate sessions with separate arrival and departure entrances.
